ja.title: GFH375の分割投与でピークは下がるか。公開PK予測を実測BIDと比べる
ja.seo_title: GFH375の分割投与と実測PK | Daiki Kumakura
ja.summary: 公開平均PK曲線にモデルを当てはめ、仮想個体2,048組で600 mg QDと300 mg BIDを比較する。推定に使わなかった公開BID曲線のピークと谷が予測と合わないことから、分割投与の予測の限界を検討する。

en.title: GFH375 dose fractionation versus observed BID pharmacokinetics
en.summary: A model fitted to the public 600 mg QD mean profile predicts a lower peak and a higher trough with 300 mg BID in 2,048 virtual individuals, but the public three-patient BID mean has a higher peak and a lower trough than predicted.
en.seo_title: GFH375 split dosing versus observed BID pharmacokinetics
en.seo_description: Fit public GFH375 PK and simulate split dosing; the predicted peak and trough disagree with the observed three-patient BID mean.

english.title: GFH375 dose fractionation: prediction versus observed BID PK
english.summary: Public aggregate PK fitting and conditional paired simulations are checked against an observed three-patient BID cohort. The peak and trough mismatch limits regimen conclusions.
